title.narrative: Upgrading of the Mombasa-Mtwapa-Kilifi road section

description.narrative: The upgrade will comprise of a dual carriageway road for the first 20 km (from Mombasa to Mtwapa) and a two-lane road for the remaining 34 km from Mtwapa to Kilifi. The Project will also include, inter alia, environmental and social mitigation measures, social complementary activities, improvements for non-motorised transport (NMT) and a trade and transport facilitation study.
